newsitem.title: USA: S. Peru Copper enters $600 mln loan pact.
newsitem.headline: S. Peru Copper enters $600 mln loan pact.

text.p: Southern Peru Copper Corp said on Thursday it entered into a committed seven year loan facility totaling $600 million with a group of international financial institutions.

The facility consists of a $400 million backstop for future issuances of secured export notes that Southern Peru Copper may place in the international capital markets and a $200 million revolving credit line.
Southern Peru Copper said the loan facility will allow the company to begin the first stage of its expansion and modernization project.
The first stage of the project is a $245 million expansion of the Cuajone mine, which will increase the company's annual copper production by 19 percent, or 130 million pounds, the company said.
The second stage of the modernization and expansion program includes the modernization and expansion of its Ilo smelter, Southern Peru Copper said.
During the modernization project, the smelter will continue to operate its existing furnaces and converters until the new plant is operating reliably at designed rates, the company said.
Following modernization, the Ilo smelter will have a sulfur recapture rate of about 95 percent, Southern Peru Copper said.
